item.title: TipiLock: 3D-Printed Top Connector for the JYSK Sminge Kids' Tipi Tent
item.description: The JYSK Sminge kids’ tipi is held up by four wooden poles that are simply tied together at the top with a cord through factory holes. During active play the whole thing wobbles, the poles spread apart, and the fabric sags. So I made a connector that rigidly ties all 4 poles together at the top and sets the correct angles. The model is parametric, written in Python with CadQuery, and slicing is automated through the headless BambuStudio CLI.
